cases.name: testWithoutComments
cases.src:
ALIASES long_method_name
    FOR if_any_interface~long_method_name .
  ALIASES short_name
    FOR if_any_interface~short_name .
  ALIASES extra_long_method_name
    FOR if_any_interface~extra_long_method_name .
cases.exp:
ALIASES long_method_name       FOR if_any_interface~long_method_name .
  ALIASES short_name             FOR if_any_interface~short_name .
  ALIASES extra_long_method_name FOR if_any_interface~extra_long_method_name .

cases.name: testWithCommentAlign
cases.src:
ALIASES long_method_name
    FOR if_any_interface~long_method_name .
  ALIASES short_name
    FOR if_any_interface~short_name . " comment
  ALIASES extra_long_method_name
    FOR if_any_interface~extra_long_method_name . " comment
cases.exp:
ALIASES long_method_name       FOR if_any_interface~long_method_name .
  ALIASES short_name             FOR if_any_interface~short_name .             " comment
  ALIASES extra_long_method_name FOR if_any_interface~extra_long_method_name . " comment

cases.name: testChain
cases.src:
ALIASES:
    short_name
      FOR if_any_interface~short_name,
    long_method_name
      FOR if_any_interface~long_method_name, " comment
    any_method
      FOR if_any_interface~any_method. " comment
cases.exp:
ALIASES: short_name       FOR if_any_interface~short_name,
           long_method_name FOR if_any_interface~long_method_name, " comment
           any_method       FOR if_any_interface~any_method.       " comment

cases.name: testCommentPreventingChange
cases.src:
ALIASES: " comment
    short_name
      FOR if_any_interface~short_name,
    long_method_name
      FOR if_any_interface~long_method_name,
    any_method
      FOR if_any_interface~any_method.
cases.exp:
ALIASES: " comment
    short_name
      FOR if_any_interface~short_name,
    long_method_name
      FOR if_any_interface~long_method_name,
    any_method
      FOR if_any_interface~any_method.

cases.name: testAcrossEmptyLine
cases.src:
ALIASES short_name
    FOR if_any_interface~short_name.
  ALIASES long_method_name
    FOR if_any_interface~long_method_name.


  ALIASES any_method
    FOR if_any_interface~any_method.
  ALIASES other_method
    FOR if_any_interface~other_method.
cases.exp:
ALIASES short_name       FOR if_any_interface~short_name.
  ALIASES long_method_name FOR if_any_interface~long_method_name.


  ALIASES any_method       FOR if_any_interface~any_method.
  ALIASES other_method     FOR if_any_interface~other_method.

cases.name: testNotAcrossEmptyLine
cases.src:
ALIASES short_name
    FOR if_any_interface~short_name.
  ALIASES long_method_name
    FOR if_any_interface~long_method_name.

  ALIASES any_method
    FOR if_any_interface~any_method.
  ALIASES other_method
    FOR if_any_interface~other_method.
cases.exp:
ALIASES short_name       FOR if_any_interface~short_name.
  ALIASES long_method_name FOR if_any_interface~long_method_name.

  ALIASES any_method   FOR if_any_interface~any_method.
  ALIASES other_method FOR if_any_interface~other_method.

cases.name: testAcrossCommentLine
cases.src:
ALIASES short_name
    FOR if_any_interface~short_name.
  ALIASES long_method_name
    FOR if_any_interface~long_method_name.
  " comment
  " more comment
  ALIASES any_method
    FOR if_any_interface~any_method.
  ALIASES other_method
    FOR if_any_interface~other_method.
cases.exp:
ALIASES short_name       FOR if_any_interface~short_name.
  ALIASES long_method_name FOR if_any_interface~long_method_name.
  " comment
  " more comment
  ALIASES any_method       FOR if_any_interface~any_method.
  ALIASES other_method     FOR if_any_interface~other_method.

cases.name: testNotAcrossCommentLine
cases.src:
ALIASES short_name
    FOR if_any_interface~short_name.
  ALIASES long_method_name
    FOR if_any_interface~long_method_name.
  " comment
  ALIASES any_method
    FOR if_any_interface~any_method.
  ALIASES other_method
    FOR if_any_interface~other_method.
cases.exp:
ALIASES short_name       FOR if_any_interface~short_name.
  ALIASES long_method_name FOR if_any_interface~long_method_name.
  " comment
  ALIASES any_method   FOR if_any_interface~any_method.
  ALIASES other_method FOR if_any_interface~other_method.

cases.name: testMultiplePeriods
cases.src:
METHOD any_method.
  ALIASES medium_method_name
    FOR if_any_interface~medium_method_name..
  ALIASES short_name
    FOR if_any_interface~short_name...
  ALIASES extra_long_method_name
    FOR if_any_interface~extra_long_method_name.
  ENDMETHOD.
cases.exp:
METHOD any_method.
  ALIASES medium_method_name     FOR if_any_interface~medium_method_name..
  ALIASES short_name             FOR if_any_interface~short_name...
  ALIASES extra_long_method_name FOR if_any_interface~extra_long_method_name.
  ENDMETHOD.
